title: JobMessage
description: ArchResidenceBD job protocol v0.1.0 (plan §5 pipeline jobs; spike S4) - the wire contract between the app and its persistent engine workers. Transport: stdlib XML-RPC on 127.0.0.1 (no new dependencies); the app picks a free port per worker at spawn and passes it in. Data plane: job(request) -> result (this schema). Control plane (frozen shapes in $defs, called as plain XML-RPC methods): ping(), stats(), shutdown(). Jobs are stateless - a fresh document per job - so a worker crash loses nothing and the job is resubmitted (S4). See docs/spec/interfaces-v0.md for kinds, deadline defaults and the watchdog policy.

jobId.description: Client-generated id; echoed by the result (results may arrive from a restarted worker, so ids must be explicit).

kind.description: Job kind v0. Per-kind params are documented in docs/spec/interfaces-v0.md; concrete param schemas land additively with the owning engine (W1.x/W2.x) - v0 freezes the envelope, the kind roster and the result contract.

params.description: Kind-specific payload (plain XML-RPC struct). Grounded examples per kind in docs/spec/interfaces-v0.md.

deadlineMs.description: Client-side per-job deadline; the client ALWAYS sets it. Defaults per kind: geometry.build 30 s, drawing.sheet 120 s, rebar.build 60 s (S4 scratch runs used 180 s).

status.description: ok = job completed; error = engine-side failure or a client-synthesized worker crash/restart (code says which); timeout = the client hit deadlineMs and synthesized this result.

artifacts.description: Always present (possibly empty). Empty on error/timeout.

warnings.description: Always present (possibly empty) - never a silent drop (plan §9).

engineVersion.description: Engine build that produced the result - provenance for determinism audits. Internal field; never shown in the UI (ADR-0004).

mediaType.description: e.g. image/svg+xml, application/pdf, image/png, application/dxf, application/json, text/plain.

sha256.description: Content hash. Determinism note (S3): SVG/DXF/PNG come out byte-stable; PDFs differ only in /CreationDate - the app normalizes that before hashing or exempts it explicitly (plan §9).

path.description: Path relative to the worker's per-job output directory; the app moves/normalizes artifacts into the project store.

code.description: Frozen error codes. worker_down/worker_restarted are client-synthesized on crash detection (S4: crash surfaces ~2 s after death; the watchdog pings every <=1 s and restarts, then the in-flight job fails with a clean error).

lastMs.description: Duration of the most recent job; absent before the first job (absence = no nulls).
